topic: Before/after review of the revised shopping board (compact pickup rows + conditional checkout-rate label)
method: Headless Google Chrome 154 full-height viewport screenshots of the local fixture QA server (production front-end code, recorded fixtures) plus DOM geometry through scripts/browser-research.mjs. Screenshots were then inspected with scripts/inspect-screenshot.mjs, which decodes the PNG with node:zlib and prints (a) a coarse luminance character map and (b) a design-token pixel report (Canton Zürich blue/soft-blue/green/red/amber, muted text, dividers). This is a layout/density/colour-region review, not OCR: all prices and labels are verified from the rendered DOM text and the API payloads, and the QA harness separately checks rendered-text contrast (WCAG AA) and horizontal overflow.
toolingLimitation: The coding agent's file-read tool rejects PNG input ('reading images is not supported'), so the model cannot see the screenshots directly. scripts/inspect-screenshot.mjs is the workaround: it exposes layout blocks, whitespace, density and colour regions at coarse resolution. Small text is not legible in the character map, so no claim of image-based reading of individual labels is made.

before.description: Fixture board before the 3-70 pickup compaction (same data, same front-end otherwise).

after.description: Fixture board with the 3-70 changes: compact pickup rows, 'Checkout rate (observed, conditional)' label, conditional missing-rate copy.

desktop1440.note: The three decision values (item subtotal / shipping / delivered total) sit in one row that ends at x=1290 inside the 1440 px viewport; the owner-reported b75e296 defect had 'Delivered total' at x=1641 inside a 1325 px container.

mobile390.note: The three pickup-only offers cost about half their former height and no longer repeat three separate three-cell cards. The best card starts 108 px below an 844 px first screen; the QA harness accepts this ('not pushed far below the first screen'), and the desktop first screen shows it at 484 px.

paletteDesktop1440.reading: Soft-blue is confined to the best-offer panel/selected context, blue to rules, the selected control, the best tag and the delivered-total value, green to verified in-stock labels, amber to coverage/uncertainty text, and red is absent because the fixture board has no unavailable offer. No arbitrary vendor colouring was observed.

asciiInspection: Desktop hero and controls occupy the top ~430 px; the best card follows immediately and its three totals cells read as one aligned row with the blue total value.
Ranked offer cards stack below in a single column with consistent left alignment and one short conditions list each; pickup rows are visibly shorter and left-bordered.
Mobile: hero, single-column controls, then the best card; the three totals cells stack but stay inside the 390 px viewport with no horizontal overflow.
Footer disclosures stay compact and below the decision content.
